threads.body:
@copilot Update this PR directly to use `library("com.oracle.database.jdbc:ojdbc8:21.1.0.0")` without a UCP exclusion in both `instrumentation/oracle-ucp-11.2/javaagent/build.gradle.kts` and `instrumentation/oracle-ucp-11.2/library/build.gradle.kts`. The user chose this newer driver instead of the current 12.2.0.1 driver plus exclusions. The published 21.1.0.0 POM has no dependencies: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/oracle/database/jdbc/ojdbc8/21.1.0.0/ojdbc8-21.1.0.0.pom. Do not create a separate PR or work on other audit rows.

Preserve the direct UCP 11.2.0.4 declarations, baseline-jar regression guard, latest-dependency mode forwarding, support claims and existing telemetry behavior. Verify that both main compile and baseline test runtime graphs still select UCP 11.2.0.4 without forced versions, and that the new driver works with that old pool against the existing real Oracle fixture. Run the targeted javaagent and standalone baseline and latest-dependency behavior suites and relevant Muzzle compatibility check after the narrow formatting tasks. Keep metrics registration/cleanup and agent pool naming/restart/rename coverage. Do not skip baseline behavior or raise the supported UCP minimum to make the change pass. If the proposed driver/pool combination genuinely cannot work, report the concrete blocker instead. Keep unrelated code untouched and preserve the PR's draft state.

replies.body: Updated both build files to use ojdbc8 21.1.0.0 without a UCP exclusion, retaining UCP 11.2.0.4; commit `973dcdf8`. Both baseline suites pass against the Oracle fixture, the four baseline compile/runtime graphs select UCP 11.2.0.4, and Muzzle passes. Latest-mode suites could not start: root configuration requires JDK 27 for an unrelated Helidon project, which is unavailable here and cannot be downloaded.
